description: Persisted light/dark theme color overrides for a tenant, so a God Panel styling change is visible to every visitor rather than only the editor's own browser (localStorage remains the instant-apply/offline cache).

id.description: Equal to tenantId — one row per tenant

lightColors.description: JSON-stringified Record<string,string> of CSS custom properties

darkColors.description: JSON-stringified Record<string,string> of CSS custom properties
